data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season, and I want this lake supporting our village for years. How about we each catch 10 tons this month? That earns each of us $10,000, leaves 50 tons to reproduce, and brings the lake back to 100 next month. We can keep that income going if we all stick to it, and review the catches together each month. John, would you agree to that?
